item.text:
Set `prefetch={true}` on each category link in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15). This asks Next to prefetch the full destination, including its category-specific heading and products, while keeping the existing `/catalog?category=...` URLs.

I didn’t run tests. Prefetching is a production behavior in Next.js, so development mode may still show the loading state.
